verdict.rationale: Environment isolation is a fair question for a serverless platform, but the pack never documents Workers environments (such as staging versus production) or any mechanism that stops non-production Workers from reaching production services. Scoped API tokens control access to the Cloudflare management API, and the generic Zero Trust mention and service Bindings are adjacent features, not environment isolation, so none of them earn credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
